integrity: Exact finite enumeration corroborates but does not establish the all-size theorem; algebraic proof provided. Relevant published work on cut rank, Shor-Laflamme moments, and uniform graph states is credited. No human or independent assessment claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for independent-edge G(n,1/2) graph states with n>=4; not a theorem about finite-depth Clifford-circuit outputs, arbitrary edge probabilities, higher-order association, or distributional convergence. Literature comparisons leave possible unindexed equivalent formulations.
title: Correlated two-qubit mixing in Erdős–Rényi graph states
